career_overview.short_description: Build the parts of websites that people see and interact with. Learn to structure pages, style layouts, add behaviour and check usability.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to frontend developer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A small, responsive multi-page website with at least one working interactive feature.

roadmap.title: Frontend Developer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A small, responsive multi-page website with at least one working interactive feature.
